definition: a bus or train that stops at every stop
description: Inside an old country bus on a warm, hazy day, a sign above the windscreen lists the stops. The aisle is crowded with passengers and their things: a white goat on a rope, a tall wooden wardrobe, a shaggy dog lying on the floor, a bicycle leaning on a seat, baskets of vegetables and a net of lemons. A man in overalls pats the goat, then walks up the aisle and stands by the wardrobe, wiping his face. Young people in shorts and T-shirts sit in the seats on both sides, and a young woman sits at the front.

taps.target: the young woman at the front
